headlines.title: Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to kill Ukrainian American rapper on its soil
headlines.description: COPENHAGEN, Denmark — Authorities thwarted the attempted killing of a Ukrainian American citizen on Danish soil in a plot allegedly orchestrated by Russian intelligence services, the Danish prime minister’s office said Friday.

headlines.title: FBI investigating potential breach of its crime database
headlines.description: The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of its National Crime Information Center, two people briefed on the matter told NBC News Friday.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.
